name: Volt Perch
tagline: Charging docks for scooters and e-bikes that don't need a babysitter.
positioning: Volt Perch runs the charging fleet behind your rental scooters and e-bikes — so batteries are full, ports work, and nobody pages you at 6am.

hero.h1: Your scooters are dead again. We noticed before you did.
hero.sub: Volt Perch is the charging dock and software SMB fleet owners use to keep e-bikes and scooters topped up, tracked, and out of the repair pile.

features.title: Ports that snitch
features.description: Every port reports voltage, temperature, and 'someone jammed a coffee cup in me' faults in real time. You get a text, not a mystery.

features.title: Never rent a dead bike
features.description: The dashboard hides any vehicle under your charge threshold until it's genuinely ready, so riders stop leaving one-star reviews about it.

features.title: Utilization you can read
features.description: See which perches earn their footprint and which ones just sit there looking pretty next to the taco truck.

features.title: Off-peak charging
features.description: We schedule charging around your utility's cheap hours automatically. Your power bill stops resembling a phone number.

features.title: Swap-and-go batteries
features.description: Track loose battery packs by serial, know which are charged, and stop losing $400 bricks in the back of a van.

features.title: Works where you park
features.description: Curbside, garage, storefront, or that questionable alley — docks are IP65 and run on a normal outlet.

testimonials.quote: We used to send a kid on a bike to check if the other bikes were charged. Now the dock just tells us. He got promoted to something less stupid.
testimonials.name: Dario Speck

testimonials.quote: Downtime dropped 40% in a month. My whole business was 'is it charged?' and Volt Perch quietly answered it forever.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandan

testimonials.quote: I bought it expecting to hate the app. I check it in the bathroom now. That's either a great review or a cry for help.
testimonials.name: Marcus Field

pricing.blurb: For the one-location operator who just wants full batteries.
For growing fleets juggling docks across a few blocks.
For city-wide fleets that page nobody, ever.

homepage.footerBlurb: Volt Perch keeps micro-mobility fleets charged so owner-operators can go home. Fewer dead bikes, fewer 6am phone calls.
